commit.message:
Disable Scissor testing when switching to 3D

There are some very select corner-cases (ex. when rendering 2D over a 3D
scene) where Prism expects 3D rendering to start with Scissor testing
disabled.

This patch adds D3D12Context.setDeviceParametersFor3D() override which
always disables scissor testing. This mirrors D3D behavior and causes
the 3D scene RTT to be properly cleared in those cases.
